ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; dominant low-intensity (black) surface pigmentation with high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters resulting from scarring and accretions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white cluster concentrated at the left distal tip; series of parallel white linear features on the left lobe; multiple isolated white circular pixel groups distributed across the central surface; textured high-intensity white mass on the right distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 65-degree interior angle; vertical pixel depth approximately 12-15% of the visible lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge boundary; frequency of peaks ranges from 30-50 pixels; amplitude variation of 5-12 pixels relative to the local edge vector.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex upward curvature originating from the median notch and extending toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast textured white pixel cluster on the right distal tip corresponding to barnacle colonization; scattered circular white spots (3-10 pixel diameter) distributed across both ventral lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of four distinct high-intensity parallel linear markings on the left distal region; multiple fine intersecting white linear disruptions visible on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel linear rake marks on the left lobe; significant barnacle encrustation on the right distal tip; numerous circular barnacle attachment scars across the ventral surface.
